rationale: The agent properly verified identity via the provided email, accessed only the authenticated user’s orders, and used read-only tools to review order details before acting. It correctly identified the gaming items and explained that refunds must go to the original payment methods. However, before performing the order-changing action (initiating the returns), the agent did not explicitly confirm with the user after stating the exact changes and clarifying that the mouse refund would go to PayPal, which differed from the user’s requested Visa refund. Policy requires explicit confirmation prior to any writes. Despite otherwise correct handling, this missing confirmation step causes the interaction to fail the pass bar.
